latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Research Paper Writer: a tool for generating formal academic papers in IEEE/ACM style.

- Guides users through clarifying research topics and paper scope.
- Provides standard academic paper structure and section guidelines.
- Enforces formal, scholarly writing style with section-specific conventions.
- Offers detailed formatting instructions for IEEE and ACM publication standards.
- Ensures proper citation and reference list formatting.
- Outlines stepwise workflow for drafting, citing, and refining research papers.
